description: This file defines the CommunicationAdminController class, which manages administrative actions related to communications (like emails or newsletters) in the Goteo project. It includes route definitions, form handling for creating/editing communications, preview rendering, activation/cancellation of email dispatches, and methods to list and detail communications.

classes.name: CommunicationAdminController
classes.description: Controller class managing admin actions for maintaining and dispatching communication messages such as emails or newsletters, including CRUD operations, preview, activation, cancellation, and listing.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'communications' for categorization purposes.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines and returns the set of routes/endpoints associated with this controller.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Handles the saving of a communication object, including processing POST data, translating texts, saving emails, and queuing messages.

methods.name: getReceivers
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving receivers based on a filter, offset, limit, and sender_id.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists communications with optional search filtering, pagination, and total count.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles creating or editing a communication, with form processing and initial data loading.

methods.name: copyAction
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of an existing communication for editing or reuse.

methods.name: previewAction
methods.description: Renders a preview of a communication email, differs if newsletter or default template.

methods.name: detailAction
methods.description: Shows details of a communication, including associated mails.

methods.name: activateAction
methods.description: Activates a communication’s mails for sending and logs the operation.
